name: @magpie-community/opencode-quick-auth
description: Amazon Quick (quick.aws.com) for OpenCode and magpie: the chat tiers — quick-fast, quick-balanced, quick-smart — relayed over the app's own CBOR WebSocket, with per-turn model fingerprints (resolved_model_id, cost, wall-clock seconds) and the session/monthly minute pools shown read-only. Sign-in is the account's browser session (Cookie header + mbtc). Unofficial.
